Hello - Je viens de rejoindre Photoroom (AI visual creation; prosumer, SMB et enterprise). Plein de projets bien sur! Nous allons lancer les recrutements long term mais entre temps je cherche des freelance pour nous soutenir 2 des projets ci-dessous. Ravie d'avoir vos referrals pour freelance (disponibilité minimum 3 jours/semaine pendant 2 mois) ou full time (je partagerai des job descs quand ils sortent)
1. *Growth marketing (SMB):* project manage launch of a product targeting Shopify store SMBs and other initiatives around SMB growth [full-time EU, can be remote; freelance flexible]. Looking for someone who isn't shy about understanding data, following up with the team on actions and can support different channels where needed 
2. *Marketing Operations (SMB & Enterprise) topics* : to support RevOps on topics such as attribution, funnel definitions, events operations; [freelance to advance these topics working remotely or Paris office while hiring full time a Head of Enterprise Marketing to be based in NYC]
